data.exact_reserve_text:
Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, included favourable prior year development of GBP 4,828k (2019: adverse development of GBP 11,550k).
The result for the year included favourable prior year development of GBP 4.8m (2019: adverse development of GBP 11.6m).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims development shows a net gross strengthening (increase in gross reserves) of approximately GBP 55.2m across prior underwriting years (2013-2018) based on the published gross claims development table. However, on a net basis (after reinsurance) the syndicate reports a small favourable prior year development of GBP 4.828m. The divergence is explained by large increases in gross estimates for older years (driven by catastrophe and large-loss development, notably in Asia Pacific) being largely offset by reinsurance recoveries and favourable run-off on other portfolios; COVID-19 exposure is reported as low. The overall picture across lines is therefore mixed (gross strengthening, net release).
raw_causal_phrases: Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, included favourable prior year development of GBP 4,828k (2019: adverse development of GBP 11,550k).
The result for the year included favourable prior year development of GBP 4.8m (2019: adverse development of GBP 11.6m).
After a number of years with material natural catastrophe events, the current year results have been impacted by lower severity catastrophe and large loss events in the Asia Pacific region.

The assessment of COVID-19 related insurance liabilities across our insurance and treaty reinsurance business reflects a low level of COVID-19 exposure to the Syndicate with our booked losses totaling GBP 4.0m on a gross basis and GBP 2.0m net.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (gross) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (current estimates vs previous diagonal) because no single-line gross 'movement in prior years' amount was provided. The report explicitly states a small favourable NET prior year development of GBP 4.828k; the large gross strengthening (~GBP 55.2m) is largely offset by reinsurer's share movements, producing the net favourable result. No specific named prior-year events were given. Figures extracted from tables presented in thousands (converted to millions).
